summary: A guest joining or leaving a host's locked booking never reached Google: the host-event patch sent time and text only, so a joined guest got no invite and a removed one kept theirs. The mock calendar did not model attendees, so tests could not see it.
fix: Patch rows written for a joined-guest change carry {attendees: true}; the gateway then GETs the event and sends the new attendee list, keeping every staying attendee's entry (and responseStatus). The mock now keeps attendees the way Google does.

summary: One 401 on a cached access token recorded last_error 'unauthorized' and sent Jon the reconnect email, even when a fresh refresh would have worked.
fix: On a 401 the gateway drops the cached token, refreshes and retries once; only a second 401 or a failed refresh reaches the alert.
